body: Digital Experience Trends 2026
Digital experiences rapidly evolving toward decentralised, AI-driven environments.
At Labyrinth Reply, AI-generated images open a new way to make film and television.
La Gazzetta dello Sport has created a multi-tenant platform offering subscription-based fitness video content, accessible anywhere.
Following an international pitch, Nissin has awarded its new European communications campaign to Triplesense Reply and Threepipe Reply.
The Creative Technology Hub of Triplesense Reply, a creative and design agency, produced a special project for the Fiat Pandina TV commercial, conceived by Publicis Collective.

Triplesense Reply announces the launch of the new website created for U-Power, a European leader in Personal Protective Equipment. An end-to-end project that marks a significant evolution of the brand’s digital ecosystem.
Threepipe Reply leads the integrated strategy for The Hundred 2025 to maximize engagement and sales.

Triplesense Reply renews its collaboration with ABB Motion Drives, and in particular with the ABB Drive Products division specializing in low-voltage frequency converters, for the launch of a new campaign dedicated to the Machinery Drives series.
The new Flee website is online, the service that aims to become the main mobility ecosystem, starting with a long-term car rental offer.
The new edition combined design, technology, and creativity, all enriched by the vibrant and colourful art of Sebastian Curi.

Bitmama Reply's new signature campaign , "Un grande traguardo è a portata di mano. Dai” represents an exhortation to make the necessary effort together to treat all women with breast cancer, a powerful invitation launched in October with the AIRC Pink Ribbon campaign initiatives.
Enhancing the accessibility of digital channels for a leading European bank to comply with global standards, improve user inclusivity and spread culture of accessibility.

Xister Reply has been a long-standing partner in Magnum Ice Cream's mission to provide novel experiences of gratification and amusement. This collaboration has resulted in the creation of an immersive virtual world on the Metaverse platform “The Nemesis”.
L.K. Bennett needed a step change in online performance. We made it possible by increasing their visibility in organic search results for core, unbranded queries.
We are a multidisciplinary team of data analysts, strategists, creatives, designers, product managers, and developers that build holistic digital experiences.
Avvio Reply is the leading employee experience agency that shapes the future of work and delivers strategic and creative solutions.
avvio.uk, avvio.it
Bitmama Reply is one of the most important Brand Experience Agencies in Italy.
bitmama.it
Elbkind Reply specialises in digital communication, with the aim of stimulating discussions, eliciting recommendations and generating interest.
elbkind.de
At Labyrinth Reply, AI-generated images open a new way to make film and television.
labyrinthreply.it
Like Reply is an expert for innovative solutions in marketing automation, SEO, SEA, marketing performance and attribution modelling.
like.com
Sagepath Reply delivers transformative digital solutions that push boundaries and drive results in B2B, B2C and Supply Chain.
sagepath.com
Reply AI Studios combines creativity, generative AI and advanced production technologies to create high-quality visual and sound experiences.
replyaistudios.it
Threepipe Reply is a brand performance agency, a team of story tellers with expertise across data, search, media, PR, creative and technology.
threepipe.com
Triplesense Reply is the specialist for Digital Strategies and Customer Experience in commercial and end customer markets.
triplesense.de, triplesense.it
The digital agency process goes from strategy to implementation, delivering not only great creativity, but also finely-crafted, finished products.
xister.com
Discover the rapid evolution of digital experiences as the strategic imperative moves from optimising owned destinations to influencing decentralised, AI-driven environments.

Reply has once again secured a place among the leading digital service providers in 2026 in the Internet Agency Ranking of the Bundesverband Digitale Wirtschaft (BVDW) through its specialized Digital Experience companies. With purely organic revenue growth, the company further strengthens its position as one of the leading players in the digital industry.

Smart assistants and hyper-personalization are redefining the future of digital experience. By blending deep technical expertise with visionary ideas, Reply has once again been recognised in the latest Lünendonk study as a top player shaping this evolving landscape.
Reply develops AI-powered solutions for adaptive, personalized experiences – securing a top position in the prestigious BVDW ranking for the eighth time in a row in 2025.

AI is currently revolutionising Digital Experience Services. With its strong innovative capabilities and its advanced AI solutions, Reply has nevertheless maintained its leading position, once again achieving a top ranking in the latest Lünendonk study.
Reply once again leading in the Internet Agency Ranking 2024 of the German Association for the Digital Economy.
